outOfScope: Rewriting BB-059 historical evidence, lineage or the invalid-merge PR record.
Changing the pinned Jev adapter identity (how-evolution-jev-adapter rev 1), model snapshot jev-1.13.0, or the SystemOne question schema.
Extending the evaluation or promotion contract beyond the currently-live v1 semantics.
Changing execution-policy currentness machinery delivered outside the how-evolution surface.
constraints: Research only in this lane: no product source edits, no self-issued readiness or fabricated Jev judgment.
Prove-first: the implementation is not assumed buggy; implementation files in sourceScope.write stay read-only unless a behavior in behaviorsToProve fails.
Status DRAFT: recovery verification has not been executed; nothing in this plan claims readiness or a Jev verdict.
Every input is labeled DELIVERED_TRUTH, PLANNED_CONTRACT or RESEARCH_DESIRED_STATE; planned contracts are never described as delivered.
No writes outside sourceScope.write; no writes to sourceScope.forbiddenWrite for any reason.
invariants: Research performs no product-code mutation; implementation files are read-only unless verification proves a behavior defect
No history rewrite: the original delivery's historical evidence and invalid-merge lineage remain facts
A pinned protocol compares exactly one baseline and one candidate HOW against one fixed semantic/acceptance subject; missing or unknown observations yield INCONCLUSIVE, never coerced to PASS
Promotion requires independent authorization and full currentness proof; any drift between evaluation and promotion refuses promotion
The Jev adapter is evaluate-only and fails closed; a Jev PASS alone cannot mutate policy, history, or product currentness
architectureDecisions: D1 -- Verification-first: rerun the six how-evolution-*.test.js suites verbatim on current main before writing any new test; new tests are added only for uncovered N1-N7 failure modes.
D2 -- Promotion racing proof: run publishHowEvolutionPromotion against an in-memory policy store with a concurrent head mutation and require the racing promotion to fail closed.
D3 -- Fresh-process provenance: exercise resolveHowEvolutionProvenance in a fresh Node process with no conversation history.

D4 -- Every N1-N7 negative case gets at least one named node:test case (e.g. an explicit test asserting createHowEvolutionJevEvaluator has no promotion/rollback methods, and an explicit promotion attempt on a RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempt), not prose-only assertions.

D5 -- Repair boundary: if a defect is found, repair stays inside how-evolution.js / how-evolution-jev-adapter.js plus the affected index re-export block, with regression evidence for the defect and the full N1-N7 set.
implementationSlices: S1 -- Pinned protocol proof [C1, C6, N6]: evaluation A/B protocol, verdict rules, Jev adapter pinning and fail-closed behavior.
S2 -- Authority separation and attempt pinning [C2, C4, N3]: producer/evaluator/promoter separation, evaluate-only adapter capability, attempt binding retention.
S3 -- Promotion currentness and rollback [C3, C5, N2, N5, N7]: four-reader currentness, head racing fail-closed, history-preserving rollback, fresh-process provenance reconstruction.
S4 -- Negative cases [N1-N7]: semantic drift, producer-evaluator conflict, Jev failure modes, forged rollback lineage, case-set mismatch.
S5 -- Living Docs and evidence packaging: doc statements bound to exact tests and artifact refs, with no Blackboard ids in user-facing text.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A pinned protocol compares exactly one baseline and one candidate HOW for one fixed semantic work/acceptance subject; evaluateHowEvolution returns PASS only when predeclared metric thresholds are met, no new critical-case failure is hidden by aggregate gain, and all case measurements are present (missing/unknown observations -> INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS).
evidenceRequired: Focused how-evolution suite output on current main. agentic-system package suite output.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Authority separation holds: a candidate producer cannot evaluate or promote its own candidate, a Jev PASS alone cannot mutate ExecutionPolicy/ProductHistory/QualityAcceptance/ProductOutcome currentness, and createHowEvolutionJevEvaluator has no repository, product, policy-publisher, promotion or rollback capability.
evidenceRequired: Focused how-evolution suite output on current main. agentic-system package suite output.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: publishHowEvolutionPromotion succeeds only after assertHowEvolutionPromotionCurrentness proves no drift in semantic subject, evaluator policy, scenario set, evidence snapshot and the expected policy head (head moved / evidence raced / semantics drifted -> promotion refused); accepted promotion creates a new immutable ExecutionPolicy/ExecutionStrategy generation for the exact domain/workload scope only.
evidenceRequired: Focused how-evolution suite output on current main. agentic-system package suite output.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: ACTIVE/RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempts retain their original ExecutionAttemptBinding across promotion; a promoted HOW version affects only eligible new attempts and promotion never rebinds a RECOVERY_REQUIRED attempt.
evidenceRequired: Focused how-evolution suite output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: publishHowEvolutionRollback publishes a successor generation to the exact prior accepted strategy, rejects rollback to non-accepted strategies and forged reversed lineages, and never rewrites prior artifacts.
evidenceRequired: Focused how-evolution suite output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The Jev receipt pins exact input/output/policy/evidence/freshness identity (model snapshot jev-1.13.0, canonical request hash, typed per-question outcomes); transport errors, malformed typed Choice responses, unexpected model, missing atomic outcomes or missing/negative authority verification all fail closed to INCONCLUSIVE/KEEP_BASELINE.
evidenceRequired: Focused how-evolution suite output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A new Node process can reconstruct the durable ref+digest chain (baseline, candidate, evaluator/policy, evidence, decision, promotion/rollback authority, resulting current policy) via resolveHowEvolutionProvenance without conversation history.
evidenceRequired: Focused how-evolution suite output on current main. Fresh-process provenance log.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Candidate changes WHAT/WorkContract/acceptance semantics mid-evaluation -> evaluation invalid / proposal non-actionable (semantic drift fails closed, re-evaluation required).

Semantic-subject, evaluator-policy, scenario-set, evidence-snapshot or head drift between evaluation and promotion -> promotion refused even if evaluation was PASS (including evidence racing after evaluation, before head mutation).
Producer == evaluator or producer == promoter; evaluator attempts to promote the candidate it judged -> authority mismatch fails closed, baseline stays current.
Jev transport failure or malformed typed Choice response, or unexpected model identity -> INCONCLUSIVE/KEEP_BASELINE, never coerced to PASS.
Rollback targeting a non-accepted strategy, a forged reversed promotion lineage, or rollback against a moved current head -> rejected.
A/B case-set identity mismatch between baseline and candidate runs, or missing case measurement -> INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.
Promotion called with only a head check (missing one of the four freshness readers) -> refused.
